details: Mushroom Bomb perk throws a mushroom spore projectile with particles/trail and an appear sound on impact.

details: Rock Throw now reads the blessedHaloDagger perk and uses a blessed projectile with a halo impact sound.

Blessed Halo ability use can heal injured friendly or neutral targets near the impact and reduce the current Rock Throw cooldown by 5% after a heal.

versionHistory.summary: Rock throw now adds an INT-scaling magical spear variant alongside damage, weapon visibility, impact, and mushroom bomb handling changes.

details: Brazen Slam variant: previously unavailable; granted by the Minotaur Hammer's Brazen Slam perk.

/versions/1358.headline: Lavalands

heroImage.alt: A blue-robed adventurer with a staff and a horned, black-armored giant with glowing red eyes fight swarms of giant mosquitoes and ants in a smoldering red canyon.
heroImage.caption: Lavalands update artwork supplied by the project owner.

includedVersions.summary: Added Minotaur weapons and helmets, reworked Cultist gear drops, new Slag Slime, Rant and Ancient Remains monsters, Candle Cult PvP rules and projectile pass-through.
Added Brazen Horns drops to Minotaurs and the Blazen Bull and made the Blazen Bull Resilient.

notes: Cultists now drop each piece of Cultist Mage, Cultist Warrior and High Cultist gear at a 1% chance (previously they dropped only Lesser Souls), and the evil-faced High Cultist now appears twice as often (selection weight 1 → 2).

The Blazen Bull now moves faster (walk speed 16 → 25) and has its own loot table with a 10% chance each for the Minoaxe and Minotaur Hammer; from v1359 it is also Resilient and has a 10% chance to drop Blazing Brazen Horns. Like the Minotaur, it now steers toward you while charging.

Candle Cult members (Kindlers) get their own PvP state: they cannot switch to Hostile or damage other players, and in certain areas their Flamelet perk makes them take 40% less PvP damage, plus 5% more for each Candle Cultist within 50 studs, up to 80% (previously there was no Candle Cult PvP state).
The Dragonslayer quest giver is now Avanth Flamewalker, who offers the Dragon Slayer quest with a new description and carries over the Dragonslayer's lore about the Dragon Slayers and the Dark Lord.
Dragonslayer Armor, Helmet and Boots won from the Bone Goblin quest are now cursebound.
The Dragon no longer announces its spawn to the server.
A new UI Scale (Minimap) setting resizes the minimap on its own, from 0.5x to 1.5x in 0.05 steps (previously the minimap followed UI Scale).

Server shutdowns now show a full-screen status while your data saves and you return to the main menu, retrying the return for up to 27 seconds, and teleport screens have a new main-menu look with a diagnostics panel you can toggle with [ or R3.
/versions/1358.summary: Beyond the scorched edge of Desolation's Hand lies Lavalands, a molten level 60 frontier where Fire Ants, Magma Slimes, Rants and Minotaurs stalk the cooling rock, Baby Dragons prowl the flows, and the Candle Cult's Kindlers keep their flames burning while Avanth Flamewalker recruits a new generation of Dragon Slayers. Minotaurs now carry the Minoaxe, the new Minotaur Hammer and Brazen Horns into battle, Cultists drop a reworked set of level 60 Cultist and High Cultist gear, and projectiles now pass harmlessly through anyone you can't damage.
